detaileddescription.para:
Measures latency and throughput for the following operations:
GraphQL parse – uncached, simple 10-field query
GraphQL parse – cache hit (same query, second call)
GraphQL parse – complex nested query (depth 4, 20+ fields)
GraphQL parse – invalid query (rejection path)
GraphQL execute – parse + execute with mock document resolver
Correlation ID generation – UUID v4 overhead (< 10 µs target)
Correlation ID check – X-Correlation-ID header present (no-op path)
JSON response serialisation – single-document response body
JSON response serialisation – paginated list (100 documents)
JSON request deserialisation – document PUT body
HTTP message build – well-formed GET request (Beast)
HTTP message build – well-formed POST request with JSON body (Beast)
REST endpoint roundtrip – GET /health through in-process server
REST endpoint roundtrip – GET /v1/documents via persistent keep-alive connection

Latency targets (from src/api/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md):
GraphQL parse+execute (10-field query): < 2 ms p99
Correlation ID generation overhead: < 10 µs/req
Build: cmake -DTHEMIS_BUILD_BENCHMARKS=ON ... && cmake build . target bench_api_endpoints Run: ./benchmarks/bench_api_endpoints benchmark_format=json
